<h2>Summarise Spatial Predictor-Inclusive Variance</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Summarises unit-level predictor-inclusive percentages for spatial variance
figures using medians and empirical 95 percent intervals.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>summarise_spatial_predictor_inclusive_variance(data_plot)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_plot">data_plot</code></td>
<td>
<p>Data frame returned by [prepare_spatial_variance_plot_data()].</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A tibble with one row per scale, resolution, and predictor domain, including
'n_units', 'median', 'lwr_95', and 'upr_95'.
</p>

</main>
